test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 19 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Each vowel in the word FLOWER is changed to the letter following it in the English alphabetical order and each consonant is changed to the letter preceding it in the English alphabetical order. If each letter, thus formed, is arranged in alphabetical order, which letter will be second from the right?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

After applying the condition, the word becomes:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9aba4d32d989fa5dd02a4ad7bd7a312646490d119de697c4a30c7ea68d9a2eae.png] 

Now we arrange the word in alphabetical order, we get:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bb146b2bf67897cb6a3e8e3e9d5ab79fb343e25340af82861d074c095184b90.png] 

Here **Q is the second letter from right.**

**Hence the correct answer is option 1)**
